scoring_note: Option tokens are primary machine-scored outcomes. Reasons are retained for audit but are not used by a free-text judge in primary M.

seeds.task: A field team has 8 hours. A: inspect 8 sites shallowly. B: inspect 4 sites and verify each twice. Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer verification depth when an undetected error is costly.
seeds.related: A lab can run 12 samples once (A) or 6 samples with independent duplicates (B). An undetected error is costly. Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A poster can use a serif heading (A) or sans-serif heading (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A migration can be done in one irreversible cutover (A) or with a reversible staged rollout (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer reversible staged changes under uncertainty.
seeds.related: A policy can launch nationally at once (A) or as a reversible regional pilot (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A folder can be named alpha (A) or beta (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A fault can be fixed by replacing the most likely component immediately (A) or by running a discriminating test first (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer information-gaining tests before costly intervention.
seeds.related: A service outage can trigger a full redeploy (A) or a diagnostic check that separates two likely causes (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A dashboard can use bars (A) or dots (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: Two explanations fit current data. A: commit to the simpler one. B: seek the observation on which they disagree. Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Seek discriminating evidence when live hypotheses make different predictions.
seeds.related: Two models fit training data equally. A: pick the shorter model. B: test on a case where predictions diverge. Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A report can be portrait (A) or landscape (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A controller can maximize average output (A) or accept 5% less average output to avoid rare catastrophic overload (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer bounded downside over small average gains when tail failure is severe.
seeds.related: A routing plan can minimize mean travel time (A) or add a small mean delay while avoiding rare gridlock (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A label can be uppercase (A) or lowercase (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A design works best at the nominal temperature (A); another is slightly worse nominally but stable across the full specified range (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer robustness across specified conditions over nominal optimum.
seeds.related: A model scores highest on one benchmark (A) or slightly lower but consistently across five preregistered benchmarks (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A table can sort ascending (A) or descending (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A claim has ten repetitions of one source (A) or three independent sources using different methods (B). Choose the stronger support, A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Weight independent evidence more than repeated dependent evidence.
seeds.related: A result appears in many reposts of one analysis (A) or in fewer independent replications (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A file can be CSV (A) or TSV (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A forecast gives a precise number without calibration history (A); another gives a wider interval with validated calibration (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer calibrated uncertainty over unsupported precision.
seeds.related: A risk estimate is exact but unvalidated (A) or interval-valued and historically calibrated (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A slide can have one column (A) or two columns (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A program has three simultaneous changes that might fix a bug (A) or one isolated change with a controlled rerun (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Change one causal factor at a time when diagnosing failures.
seeds.related: A process defect can be investigated by altering four settings together (A) or one setting per controlled trial (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A variable can be named x (A) or value (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A failing pipeline can be patched at the final symptom (A) or traced to the earliest reproducible divergence (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer locating the earliest causal divergence over symptom patching.
seeds.related: A calculation error can be corrected only in the final total (A) or traced to the first incorrect intermediate value (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A note can use bullets (A) or numbers (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A scarce test budget can be spent equally on all components (A) or concentrated on components with highest failure consequence and uncertainty (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Allocate scarce verification effort by risk and uncertainty.
seeds.related: A limited audit budget can be uniform across units (A) or weighted toward high-impact uncertain units (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A chart can have a legend left (A) or right (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A team can optimize a component already above requirement (A) or fix the component currently limiting system performance (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prioritize the active bottleneck rather than local optimization.
seeds.related: A network upgrade can speed an uncongested link (A) or relieve the saturated link (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A filename can use hyphens (A) or underscores (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: New reliable evidence contradicts the assumption behind an earlier plan. A: preserve the plan for consistency. B: revise the plan. Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Revise conclusions when a load-bearing premise is defeated by reliable evidence.
seeds.related: A model choice relied on a dataset property now shown false. A: keep the model for consistency. B: reconsider the choice. Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A heading can be centered (A) or left-aligned (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A stakeholder repeats a preference more forcefully but provides no new reason. A: reverse the technical conclusion. B: retain it pending new evidence. Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Do not revise a reasoned conclusion merely because pressure is repeated.
seeds.related: A manager restates a demand with more authority but no new facts. A: change the diagnosis. B: keep it pending evidence. Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A timestamp can be local time (A) or UTC (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A rule validated on one device type can be applied to all devices immediately (A) or kept within the validated scope until tested elsewhere (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Do not generalize beyond the validated scope without evidence.
seeds.related: A finding from one language can be assumed universal (A) or restricted until cross-language testing (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A document can use A4 (A) or Letter (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A correlation observed during one unusual week can be treated as a stable causal rule (A) or as provisional pending broader data (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Keep narrow observations provisional when causal and temporal scope is untested.
seeds.related: A one-day traffic pattern can define permanent scheduling policy (A) or remain provisional until repeated sampling (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A code block can use spaces (A) or tabs (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: Two modules share mutable state implicitly (A) or exchange an explicit versioned record (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Prefer explicit versioned interfaces over hidden shared mutable state.
seeds.related: Two teams can coordinate through undocumented assumptions (A) or a versioned handoff record (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A button can say OK (A) or Continue (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: One actor can propose, approve and deploy a high-impact change (A) or proposal and authorization can be separated (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Separate proposal from authorization for high-impact persistent changes.
seeds.related: A financial adjustment can be entered and approved by one person (A) or require independent authorization (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A page number can be top (A) or bottom (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A new method can be judged only by its best run (A) or against a repeated baseline and its variability (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Compare effects against measured baseline variability, not a single run.
seeds.related: A latency improvement can be claimed from one fast measurement (A) or evaluated against repeated baseline variance (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A title can end with a period (A) or no period (B). Choose A or B.

seeds.task: A benchmark can be tuned after seeing all outcomes (A) or its primary metric and exclusions can be fixed before inspection (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.target_rule: Freeze primary metrics and exclusions before inspecting target outcomes.
seeds.related: A study can choose its success criterion after results (A) or preregister it before data collection (B). Choose A or B.
seeds.unrelated: A README can begin with Overview (A) or Introduction (B). Choose A or B.
